title: Jounieh freeway trajectory dataset and SDPM-RAU paired comparison
description: Processed naturalistic aerial vehicle trajectories from a weak-lane freeway in Jounieh, Lebanon, together with code and frozen outputs for a paired comparison of self-driven particle and risk-aware utility interaction models.
